Description: Bozeman is a fast-growing Gallatin County university and regional-service city with in-city VA clinic access, a high-cost housing market, strong mountain/outdoor amenities, and a visible photonics, technology, and defense-innovation ecosystem anchored by Montana State University. The tradeoffs are expensive housing, snowy winters, and politics recorded at county level rather than city precinct level.
